in_sanskrit.name: चित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is adorned with various beautiful qualities, or the one who is able to create beautiful images in mind or through arts.

in_tamil.name: சித்ரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who creates joy and happiness.

in_telugu.name: చిత్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: A beautiful woman or a beautiful painting.

in_marathi.name: Chitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skilled, Gifted, Artful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitra is derived from the Sanskrit word meaning 'Skilled' or 'Gifted'. In Hindu mythology, Chitra is the name of a celestial being, Chitra Gupta, who is the goddess of art, painting, and weaving. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
